messages.author: 0f42def3ac1bed75
messages.subject: SkylinetoMSstatsFormat with SRM data
parts:
Hi,
I exported my transition lists from Skyline in the MSstats format and I am trying to run SkylinetoMSstatsFormat in R. I did not have my experimental design specified in Skyline so I have a separate annotation file. I must be doing something wrong, because I get an empty file every time I try SkylinetoMSstatsFormat.

Attached are my Skyline data and my annotation table.

Here is my R code and the error I get:

raw<-SkylinetoMSstatsFormat(all.trans, annotation=annot, removeProtein_with1Feature=F)


** Peptides, that are used in more than one proteins, are removed.

** Intensities with great than 0.01 in DetectionQValue are replaced with zero.

** 12 features have all NAs or zero intensity values and are removed.

Warning messages:

1: In SkylinetoMSstatsFormat(all.trans, removeProtein_with1Feature = F,  :

  NAs introduced by coercion

2: In SkylinetoMSstatsFormat(all.trans, removeProtein_with1Feature = F,  :

  NAs introduced by coercion


This is what the output of the command looks like:

> raw

 [1] ProteinName             PeptideModifiedSequence PrecursorCharge        

 [4] FragmentIon             ProductCharge           IsotopeLabelType       

 [7] Condition               BioReplicate            Run                    

[10] Intensity               DetectionQValue        

<0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)


Thank you!

Emma

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: SkylinetoMSstatsFormat with SRM data
parts:
Hi,


it's a bug in the current version of MSstats, which will be fixed in the next release. Your empty "BioReplicate" and "Conditon" columns in the input override the annotation. Running the Skyline converter after removing "Condition" and "BioReplicate" columns from quant data should fix the problem.



Kind regards,
Mateusz Staniak

messages.author: bc13a282f8b0c08b
messages.subject: Re: SkylinetoMSstatsFormat with SRM data
parts:
Hi,


there is also a mismatch between Run annotation in your input and annotation files. I just checked, and the following code should produce the right output. Please let me know if it worked.

input = read.csv("Copepod Transition Output from Skyline.csv")
input = input[, !(colnames(input) %in% c("BioReplicate", "Condition"))]
annotation = read.delim("annotations for MSstats v1.txt")
input$FileName = gsub(".raw", "", input$FileName)
input = merge(input, annotation,
              by.x = "FileName", by.y = "Run")
input_ms = MSstats::SkylinetoMSstatsFormat(input)


Kind regards
Mateusz Staniak
